## Middle Opening SOP

**Position:** Middle (grill and fried items)

## Purpose

Get the Middle station stocked and ready for dine-in, take-out and banquet orders before service.

## START-UP PROCEDURES

### 1. Start

- Wash hands, put on apron, clock in on time
- Check with the head chef for specials and expected volume
- Check all special items

### 2. Salad Toppings

- Stock all salad toppings from the PAR list: sliced tomatoes, lemon wedges, blue cheese crumbles, pickle spears, green olives, Kalamata olives, pickled eggs, diced roasted red peppers, mozzarella balls, leaf lettuce
- Cover, label and date anything new

### 3. Grill and Proteins

- Grill mark salmon and rotate it out of the freezer
- Check steaks for salads
- Stock and rotate chicken
- Stock and rotate sausage links
- Cook off potatoes

### 4. Cut and Check

- Cut the bruschetta mix
- Check the giardiniera mayo and the cocktail sauce for calamari

### 5. Freezer Stock

- Stock and rotate freezer items: veal, chicken and eggplant parmesan; chicken wings and boneless wings; calamari; French fries; onion rings; cheese sticks
- Oldest product goes to the front

### 6. Final Readiness Check

- Every item on the Middle PAR sheet is at par
- Grill is on and clean
- Anything low is reported to the head chef before service

## Opening Standards

Rotate stock, oldest first

Label and date everything that is cut or opened

Report low stock to the head chef before service starts

## Middle Closing SOP

**Position:** Middle (grill and fried items)

## Purpose

Store the station's food safely, clean it fully and leave it ready for the next day.

## CLOSING PROCEDURES

### 1. Food

- Cover and store leftover items, replacing containers when needed
- Label and date what is stored
- Store or restock items for tomorrow
- Note anything low and tell the head chef

### 2. Clean the Station

- Take dirty items to the dish room
- Wipe down all surfaces
- Clean the grill

### 3. Floors

- Sweep, including under the grill and other equipment
- Mop the floors
- Help with the floors of the rest of the kitchen

### 4. Trash

- Empty the trash and replace the liner

### 5. Final Check

- All food covered, labeled and put away
- Surfaces clean, grill clean
- Floors swept and mopped
- Head chef told about low stock
- Check out with the kitchen lead

## Closing Standards

Do not leave dirty items at the station

Use sanitizing solution and clean rags to finish

Report low stock before you leave

## Fryer Opening SOP

**Position:** Fryer (fried items, and helping Spoon with ravioli, gnocchi and tortellini)

## Purpose

Get the fryer and its station stocked and ready for dine-in, take-out and banquet orders before service.

## START-UP PROCEDURES

### 1. Start

- Wash hands, put on apron, clock in on time
- Check with the head chef for specials and expected volume
- Check all special items

### 2. Fryer

- Make sure the fryer is on
- Check the oil and filter out particles with the spider

### 3. Stock the Station

- Stock and rotate the core fry items: chicken parm, veal parm, eggplant parm, French fries, chicken licken, chicken wings, cheese sticks, onion rings, calamari
- Stock the boil items: cheese, meat and lobster ravioli, gnocchi, cheese and meat tortellini
- Rotate wings and boneless wings from the freezer, oldest first

### 4. Help

- Help prep and the other line stations set up

### 5. Final Readiness Check

- Fryer is on and up to temperature
- Station is stocked to the Fryer list in the overview
- Anything low is reported to the head chef before service

## Opening Standards

Rotate stock, oldest first

Report low stock before service starts
